blocks.orig: The Serengeti Mara River Camp lies amidst the acacias and verdant meadows of the northern Serengeti, just 300 meters from the famous Mara River. With 10 suites (twin and double), this camp offers quick access to the wildebeest river crossing of the Great Migration during the long dry season from July to October. The tented rooms on stone platforms are classically decorated in wooden tones and brown colours with black-and-white photographs decorating the walls. The bathroom is lush and comfy, as is the netted four-poster bed, and the terrace offers the most splendid view. After a day of following the herds crossing the river (if you were lucky enough!), this is the perfect place to recuperate with a good hot rainshower, a dinner of fresh and delicious food, and a good night’s sleep in a comfy bed under a beautiful thatched roof.
blocks.html: Set among the acacias and green meadows of the northern Serengeti, the Serengeti Mara River Camp is only 300 meters from the famous Mara River. The camp has 10 suites (twin and double) and puts you close to the wildebeest river crossing of the Great Migration in the long dry season from July to October. The tented rooms stand on stone platforms and have a classic style in wood tones and browns, with black-and-white photographs on the walls. The bathroom is luxurious and comfortable, just like the four-poster bed with its mosquito net, and the terrace has a wonderful view. After a day tracking the herds across the river (if luck was on your side!), this is the ideal spot to recover with a hot rainshower, a dinner of fresh, tasty food, and a sound night’s sleep in a comfortable bed beneath a lovely thatched roof.
